content.en: Turnkey operation managed by Retaj Hotels & Hospitality guarantees optimal occupancy, guest loyalty, and periodic rental yields in USD.

content.en: Refined family-centric hospitality respecting GCC family privacy, paired with rare medicinal magnetic sands and historic natural thermal springs.
